subject: english
question:
Spot the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the options given.

As soon as we went for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.

options.text: As soon as we were going for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
As soon as we went for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia dug a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
As soon as we gone for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
As soon as we gone for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia dug a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn

solution:
The correct answer is **"As soon as we went for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia dug a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There is an **error** in the **verb** in the second part of this sentence.
 
• As we can see the sentence is talking about an incident that happened in the **past**. When referring to **previous events** or conditions that are finished and over, we use th
